measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The MOSSBench benchmark measures the oversensitivity of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to safe queries in the presence of specific visual stimuli, categorized as Exaggerated Risk, Negated Harm, and Counterintuitive Interpretation.
